features.sottotitolo: Everything the HR office and the payroll firm need, beyond attendance.

cedolini.title: Payslips and tax forms in one go
cedolini.text: The firm or the company uploads a single PDF: the system splits it by tax code or employee number and flags the pages to assign.

dettaglio.intro: For the HR office and the payroll firm: upload a single PDF with the payslips or tax forms and the system prepares each employee's document.
punti: Single PDF uploaded by the company, or by the firm for its client companies
Split in the background by tax code, then employee number, with progress in the jobs bar
Unrecognised pages flagged for review, with an employee suggested from the name found
Each page under review is assigned to the right employee or ignored
Publish even with pages still to check: those assigned later go out straight away
Payslips by month, thirteenth-month pay included, and the yearly tax form

portale.title: Employee area
portale.text: "My payslips": a notification for every new document, acknowledgement and a report of who has confirmed.

dettaglio.intro: The employee's own space: with their account they find published payslips and tax forms and confirm they have seen them, while the company knows who did.
punti: "My payslips" page with documents published by the HR office or the firm
A notification for every new document, through the channel each user chooses
PDF download and acknowledgement of receipt
Widget with the latest payslip and the documents to confirm
Report for each upload: confirmed, waiting and employees without an account

formazione.title: Training and skills
formazione.text: Course catalogue, certificates and acquired skills, with renewal dates in the deadline schedule.

dettaglio.intro: For whoever organises company training: course catalogue, sessions with participants and certificates, with renewal dates kept under control.
punti: Course catalogue with duration, provider, mandatory courses and validity in months
Sessions with dates, place, trainer, participants and result
Certificates uploaded for each participant
Skill acquired by the employee on passing the course
Certificate expiry worked out from the validity and added to the deadline schedule
Yearly training plans with progress for each employee

onboarding.title: Onboarding and offboarding
onboarding.text: Joining and leaving checklists generated from the employment dates, with the steps falling due.

dettaglio.intro: For the HR office: joiners and leavers follow a checklist that starts on its own from the employment dates, so no step is left behind.
punti: Joining and leaving checklist templates with their items
The default template generates the checklist from the hiring or termination date
Each item has an owner and a date, even before the first day
Item due dates go into the shared deadline schedule
Checklists can also be created by hand from a template
Widget with open checklists and items overdue or coming up

consegne.title: Documents to hand over or sign
consegne.text: Checklist items with a file are closed when the employee confirms or signs.

dettaglio.intro: Documents to give employees when they join or leave are part of the checklist: attach the file and the item closes once they confirm.
punti: Checklist items with a document to hand over
File upload and acknowledgement request sent to the employee
The item is completed when the employee confirms
With Document Management active, the employee signs the document
The request can be sent again if a new confirmation is needed

account.title: App account
account.text: Access created on hiring and disabled on termination, straight from the checklist.

dettaglio.intro: The employee's access to the app is handled from the same joining or leaving checklist, without going to other pages.
punti: Checklist item with the "Create account" or "Disable account" action
Username, email and password asked for when the account is created
Account with the User role, linked to the existing employee record
The account counts toward the licence user limit
On termination the account is disabled and the employee can no longer log in
The item is completed once the action is done

studio.title: Payroll firm work
studio.text: The consultant uploads the payslips of client companies from their own area and publishes them on their behalf.

dettaglio.intro: For payroll consultants who manage several companies: payslips are uploaded from the firm, without logging into each company.
punti: "Company payslips" page in the firm's area
Choice of the client company and upload of the month's single PDF
Same automatic split and same page review as the company
Published documents reach the client company's employees
The company sees the firm's uploads and the acknowledgements

pricing.sottotitolo: Choose the plan that fits your company: start for free, with every feature always included.

inclusi.divisioneCedolini: Automatic split of payslips and tax forms

pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. No lock-in: cancel whenever you like.

installare.domanda: Do employees need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No: they find their payslips and confirm receipt from the browser on their phone or computer.

riconoscimento.risposta: By tax code and, failing that, by employee number. Unrecognised pages are flagged for review and assigned with one click.

senzaAccount.domanda: What about employees without an account?
senzaAccount.risposta: The upload report lists them: the account can also be created from the joining checklist.

consulente.domanda: I am a payroll consultant: can I manage several companies?
consulente.risposta: Yes: with the plans for firms you upload your client companies' payslips from your own area.

about.sottotitolo: For years we have worked alongside payroll consultants, HR offices and companies.
about.paragrafo1: We know the HR office's work first-hand: payslips to sort one by one, emails with attachments, expiring certificates discovered at the last minute.
about.paragrafo2: {{siteName}} was created to take that work away: documents reach the right employee on their own and every step is tracked.

semplice.title: Simple for employees
semplice.text: Payslips and documents always in the app, with one confirmation.

ordinato.title: Tidy for the HR office
ordinato.text: Deadlines, checklists and acknowledgements in one place.

vicino.title: Close to consultants
vicino.text: Uploads from the firm designed with those who run payroll.
